universe: FHA forward loans, CFPB HMDA 2025; lenders with >=500 decisioned applications
method: Expected denial rate = applicant/loan profile-standardised peer expectation (state x amount x income x DTI x CLTV cells; cells with n<25 fall back to national). adjusted_ratio = observed / expected.
boundaries: Not evidence of misconduct or discrimination.
HMDA contains no credit scores; expectation is a mix proxy, not a risk model.
Rows with profile_coverage_pct below 70 cannot be interpreted alone.
Not a prediction for any individual application.

rows.lender_name: Gold Star Mortgage Financial Group, Corporation

minimum_sample_rule: 500+ decisioned applications per lender; peer cell n>=25; rows below 70% profile coverage or 1,000 applications are screening_only
